test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, G, H, and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only one person sits between H and I when counted from the right of H. Only one person sits between I and C. Only one person sits between H and G. Only two people sit between A and C. Only one person sits between B and G. Who sits third to the right of D ?
solution:
Given A, B, C, D, G, H, and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only one person sits between H and I when counted from the right of H.

Only one person sits between I and C.

Only one person sits between H and G.

Only two people sit between A and C.

Only one person sits between B and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b3c3fa8cbe3c2cef20575e15d1bbce428cfdb0b9e19599f72360d34a4b831e8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f50eb0d36d6b2d34575ab2a6513a26b3b0eb1614c44214286a089db1a24a7c33.png] 

And D sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a4ded05451137ed71b6294fe5ca9295e7b2666e8ee08f2cdc2390fb7e84ec7d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b495107d10e0215c81120f565c1b742e1bce6aee68858cfe390b72361148b437.png] 

"I" sits third to the right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
